meta.name: road-tunnel-twin-bore
meta.notes: ILLUSTRATION ONLY. A worked example showing how a complete design is assembled: an 11 m twin-bore road tunnel, a 150 MW Class A fire load, a bimodal high-pressure head on two ceiling rows, and the site's own engineering limits declared in `constraints`. Every number here is an example, not a recommendation. The `ahj` block is deliberately empty: SOLIT2 Annex 7 7.1 leaves every acceptance limit to the authority having jurisdiction.

constraints.note: Site and procurement limits this example project imposes. NOT from SOLIT2 and not acceptance criteria: the feeder capacity available at this portal, and the discharge density the installed pump power leaves headroom for. They are judged separately from the Annex 7 criteria and a breach is not a SOLIT2 failure. The density figure is an illustration of a site declaring its own limit, not a recommended one: exceeding it costs the design score points and nothing more, and leaving it out means no limit applies at any density.
